name: hud_clear_banner_counts_lives_lost
description: A wave's clear banner says what got through cost (playtest halv s1: 'Wave 6 cleared · +20 gold' after the Bristlesow took 5 lives, with no word of the leak on screen). The plan bot holds the classic match; in wave 1 two Gourdlings are let through to the Holdfast and the banner says 'Wave 1 cleared · 2 lives lost · +N gold', in wave 2 one ('1 life lost'), and wave 3, which costs nothing, keeps the plain 'Wave 3 cleared · +N gold'.

steps.assert: Game.lives == 18 and node('BannerTitle').text.begins_with('Wave 1 cleared · 2 lives lost · +') and node('BannerTitle').text.ends_with(' gold')
steps.msg: two Gourdlings got through: the clear says the two lives

steps.assert: Game.lives == 17 and node('BannerTitle').text.begins_with('Wave 2 cleared · 1 life lost · +') and node('BannerTitle').text.ends_with(' gold')
Game.lives == 17 and node('BannerTitle').text.begins_with('Wave 3 cleared · +') and not node('BannerTitle').text.contains('lost')
steps.msg: a wave that cost nothing keeps the plain clear
